title: Dimensions of Image Style
description: Analysed from a random smartphone image taken in Denmark.

latent_dimensions.name: Color Temperature
latent_dimensions.explanation: Controls the warmth or coolness of the image tones
latent_dimensions.example_value: #87CEEB sky with moderate green vegetation

latent_dimensions.name: Contrast Level
latent_dimensions.explanation: Degree of tonal separation between light and dark areas
latent_dimensions.example_value: Clear shadow from the man on pebbles, yet details visible

latent_dimensions.name: Scene Realism
latent_dimensions.explanation: Degree to which the image mimics real-world lighting and texture
latent_dimensions.example_value: Shoreline textures and foliage appear true-to-life

latent_dimensions.name: Framing Balance
latent_dimensions.explanation: Symmetry and weight distribution in the composition
latent_dimensions.example_value: Coastline guiding eye diagonally, figure offset to the right

latent_dimensions.name: Light Source Clarity
latent_dimensions.explanation: How defined and directional the light source appears
latent_dimensions.example_value: Sunlight casting gentle, soft-edged shadows

latent_dimensions.name: Grain Texture
latent_dimensions.explanation: The visibility and strength of image texture or photographic grain
latent_dimensions.example_value: Subtle grain visible in beach stones and cliff face

latent_dimensions.name: Color Saturation
latent_dimensions.explanation: Intensity of the colors used in the image
latent_dimensions.example_value: Lush greens, deep blue sea, but not oversaturated

latent_dimensions.name: Depth Perception
latent_dimensions.explanation: The sense of distance and spatial layering in the image
latent_dimensions.example_value: Foreground pebbles and distant sea line clearly separated

latent_dimensions.name: Movement Suggestion
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much implied motion is present in the image
latent_dimensions.example_value: Gentle waves, walking posture of man

latent_dimensions.name: Nature Dominance
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much of the image is occupied by natural elements
latent_dimensions.example_value: Sea, cliffs, and vegetation make up majority of frame

latent_dimensions.name: Human Presence Subtlety
latent_dimensions.explanation: How prominent or intrusive the human figure appears
latent_dimensions.example_value: Single person placed low and off to the side

latent_dimensions.name: Horizon Line Prominence
latent_dimensions.explanation: Visibility and compositional dominance of the horizon
latent_dimensions.example_value: Soft line where sky meets sea in top third of image

latent_dimensions.name: Ambient Light Mood
latent_dimensions.explanation: Overall feeling of lighting across the scene
latent_dimensions.example_value: Bright daylight with soft contrast

latent_dimensions.name: Visual Simplicity
latent_dimensions.explanation: How minimal or cluttered the visual composition appears
latent_dimensions.example_value: Clean lines, few objects, no visual noise

latent_dimensions.name: Detail Sharpness
latent_dimensions.explanation: Crispness and definition of image details
latent_dimensions.example_value: Edges of rocks and cliff vegetation clearly visible

latent_dimensions.name: Foreground Emphasis
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much visual weight is given to the closest part of the image
latent_dimensions.example_value: Rocks and man provide anchoring without dominating

latent_dimensions.name: Color Palette Harmony
latent_dimensions.explanation: How well the colors blend and complement each other
latent_dimensions.example_value: Earthy browns, greens, and cool blue sea tones

latent_dimensions.name: Line Flow
latent_dimensions.explanation: How the visual lines guide the viewer's eye
latent_dimensions.example_value: Curved coastline draws eye from figure to horizon

latent_dimensions.name: Narrative Suggestion
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much the image implies a story or human experience
latent_dimensions.example_value: Elderly man walking with poles along coastal path

latent_dimensions.name: Temporal Atmosphere
latent_dimensions.explanation: Time of day and temporal mood (pastoral, timeless, fleeting)
latent_dimensions.example_value: Midday sun with no nostalgic or futuristic cues

title: John Cleese Style Humor
description: Analyzed from John Cleese's comedy style, focusing on cynicism and punchline ambiguity. Perfect for creating witty, slightly cynical humor.

latent_dimensions.name: Cynicism Level
latent_dimensions.explanation: Indicates how skeptical or distrustful the humor is toward institutions or professions
latent_dimensions.example_value: people couldn't figure out which side of the stamp to spit on

latent_dimensions.name: Punchline Ambiguity
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much the joke relies on indirectness or misdirection
latent_dimensions.example_value: which side of the stamp to spit on

latent_dimensions.name: Authority Satire
latent_dimensions.explanation: Degree of mockery or critique aimed at figures of authority or respect
latent_dimensions.example_value: commemorative stamps commemorating lawyers

latent_dimensions.name: Formality of Language
latent_dimensions.explanation: The level of structured, formal, or polished language used
latent_dimensions.example_value: they had to withdraw them

latent_dimensions.name: Historical Irony
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much the humor draws on or twists established traditions or respected symbols
latent_dimensions.example_value: The U.S. Postal Service... commemorative stamps

latent_dimensions.name: Delivery Sharpness
latent_dimensions.explanation: The abruptness or smoothness of the punchline delivery
latent_dimensions.example_value: spit on

latent_dimensions.name: Absurdity Level
latent_dimensions.explanation: The degree of irrationality or surrealism in the humor
latent_dimensions.example_value: which side of the stamp to spit on

latent_dimensions.name: Cultural Specificity
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much the joke relies on a specific cultural context
latent_dimensions.example_value: The U.S. Postal Service

latent_dimensions.name: Moral Edginess
latent_dimensions.explanation: Degree to which the joke challenges ethical norms or sensitivities
latent_dimensions.example_value: spit on and its implied disdain

latent_dimensions.name: Cleverness Quotient
latent_dimensions.explanation: The level of intellectual play or wordplay in the joke
latent_dimensions.example_value: couldn't figure out which side of the stamp to spit on as misdirection

latent_dimensions.name: Nostalgic Tone
latent_dimensions.explanation: Level of old-fashioned or retro feeling in the humor
latent_dimensions.example_value: postal service stamps

latent_dimensions.name: Visual Imagination Trigger
latent_dimensions.explanation: How easily the joke conjures a mental image
latent_dimensions.example_value: which side of the stamp to spit on

latent_dimensions.name: Temporal Specificity
latent_dimensions.explanation: How anchored the humor is to a specific time period
latent_dimensions.example_value: postal service stamps

latent_dimensions.name: Irony Density
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much of the joke relies on irony
latent_dimensions.example_value: commemorative stamps commemorating lawyers

latent_dimensions.name: Use of Wordplay
latent_dimensions.explanation: Extent of puns, double meanings, or phonetic tricks
latent_dimensions.example_value: spit on as both literal and symbolic

latent_dimensions.name: Social Commentary Depth
latent_dimensions.explanation: Level of embedded social critique or observation
latent_dimensions.example_value: lawyers as a target of mild satire

latent_dimensions.name: Syllabic Rhythm
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much the joke flows rhythmically in its syllables
latent_dimensions.example_value: which side of the stamp to spit on

latent_dimensions.name: Sarcasm Intensity
latent_dimensions.explanation: The harshness or bite of the sarcastic tone
latent_dimensions.example_value: people couldn't figure out which side of the stamp to spit on

latent_dimensions.name: Professional Stereotype Use
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much the joke depends on professional clichés or generalizations
latent_dimensions.example_value: lawyers as untrustworthy stereotype

latent_dimensions.name: Nostalgic Tone
latent_dimensions.explanation: Level of old-fashioned or retro feeling in the humor
latent_dimensions.example_value: postal service stamps

title: Website Design Dimensions
description: Analyzed from a modern website design, focusing on visual hierarchy and user experience elements.

latent_dimensions.name: Visual Hierarchy
latent_dimensions.explanation: How clearly the design guides the user's attention through different elements
latent_dimensions.example_value: Clear heading structure with distinct font sizes and weights

latent_dimensions.name: Color Scheme
latent_dimensions.explanation: The overall color palette and how colors are used throughout the design
latent_dimensions.example_value: Primary blue with white and gray accents

latent_dimensions.name: Typography Style
latent_dimensions.explanation: The font choices and how text is presented
latent_dimensions.example_value: Modern sans-serif fonts with good readability

latent_dimensions.name: Layout Structure
latent_dimensions.explanation: How content is organized and arranged on the page
latent_dimensions.example_value: Organized grid layout with clear sections

latent_dimensions.name: White Space Usage
latent_dimensions.explanation: How empty space is used to create breathing room
latent_dimensions.example_value: Plenty of padding and margins around elements

latent_dimensions.name: Interactive Elements
latent_dimensions.explanation: How buttons, links, and interactive components are designed
latent_dimensions.example_value: Gentle hover effects and smooth transitions

latent_dimensions.name: Content Density
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much information is presented in a given space
latent_dimensions.example_value: Good balance of content without feeling cluttered

latent_dimensions.name: Brand Presence
latent_dimensions.explanation: How prominently the brand identity is displayed
latent_dimensions.example_value: Consistent branding with logo and color scheme

latent_dimensions.name: Navigation Clarity
latent_dimensions.explanation: How easy it is to find and use navigation elements
latent_dimensions.example_value: Obvious navigation menu with clear labels

latent_dimensions.name: Mobile Responsiveness
latent_dimensions.explanation: How well the design adapts to different screen sizes
latent_dimensions.example_value: Design adapts smoothly to mobile and tablet screens

latent_dimensions.name: Loading Performance
latent_dimensions.explanation: How quickly the design loads and becomes interactive
latent_dimensions.example_value: Quick loading times with smooth interactions

latent_dimensions.name: Accessibility
latent_dimensions.explanation: How well the design accommodates users with different abilities
latent_dimensions.example_value: Proper contrast ratios and keyboard navigation

latent_dimensions.name: Content Readability
latent_dimensions.explanation: How easy it is to read and understand the content
latent_dimensions.example_value: Clear typography with good contrast and spacing

latent_dimensions.name: Visual Consistency
latent_dimensions.explanation: How uniform the design elements are throughout
latent_dimensions.example_value: Uniform styling across all pages and components

latent_dimensions.name: Call-to-Action Prominence
latent_dimensions.explanation: How prominently action buttons and links are displayed
latent_dimensions.example_value: Obvious buttons with clear purpose and styling

latent_dimensions.name: Information Architecture
latent_dimensions.explanation: How logically content is organized and structured
latent_dimensions.example_value: Clear content hierarchy with intuitive organization

latent_dimensions.name: Visual Appeal
latent_dimensions.explanation: Overall aesthetic attractiveness of the design
latent_dimensions.example_value: Clean, modern design with professional appearance

latent_dimensions.name: User Experience Flow
latent_dimensions.explanation: How smoothly users can navigate and complete tasks
latent_dimensions.example_value: Intuitive user journey with clear next steps

latent_dimensions.name: Technical Sophistication
latent_dimensions.explanation: Level of advanced technical features and capabilities
latent_dimensions.example_value: Contemporary web technologies with good performance

latent_dimensions.name: Content Relevance
latent_dimensions.explanation: How well the content matches user expectations and needs
latent_dimensions.example_value: Content directly addresses user needs and goals
